text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Heavy rains continued pounding large parts of Zimbabwe over the last three days with some areas receiving their first heavy storms since the start of the season.
- The Agricultural Finance Corporation's proposed Agribank is epected to be launched by mid-year if all the legal and administrative formalities have been completed.
